text:
Ava (CS): quick heads-up — during KiteMetrics onboarding we saw 98th pct latency spikes around 1.2s on generate for ~512-token requests. Recommend a small canary: try an int4 quantized compact model + split routing to reduce tail latency and cost.

Devin S.: SGTM. I can stand up a 5% canary in Dedicated. Need the eval prompts and latency SLOs from CS. Also suggest batching tweak: target_batch_size=8, max_wait_ms=10.

Sunil R. (ML): int4 usually gives nice perf but watch quality on numeric extraction and long-form. Propose A/B with a 20-prompt eval suite (ROUGE/EM + manual checks). Define guardrail: ROUGE delta >= -2 and hallucination_rate <= baseline+1%. Also enable KV-cache warmup on canary pods.

Priya K. (Solutions): Optimize flagged KiteMetrics as "high prefix reuse" — enabling prefix caching + per-customer routing will compound gains (~15% token reduction). I recommend routing repeated sessions to cached workers & lowering cold-start weight.

Ava (CS): Plan: canary 5% for 48h, metrics to watch = 95/98 latency, p99, token cost, ROUGE, error-rate. If metrics pass, scale to 25% then 100% over 7d. I'll schedule rollout Tue after their ops window.

Chaya @KiteMetrics: thanks — timeline works. Main concern is scoring drift on our scoring pipeline. We'll need a quick rollback path.

Devin S.: will add automatic fallback route to redwood/standard-v1 if quality checks trip. Draft canary config below.

```yaml
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration: 48h
models:
  - name: redwood/compact-v2-int4
    quant: int4
  - name: redwood/standard-v1
    fallback: true
routing:
  prefer: low-latency
  health_checks: [perplexity, latency, error_rate]
batching:
  target_batch_size: 8
  max_wait_ms: 10
```

Sunil R. (ML): I'll prepare the eval harness and baseline results before Tuesday and add a small manual-check rota for edge cases.

Devin S.: will prepare deploy scripts and post the exact curl/deploy command here. Draft deploy command below for planning: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deploys \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"account":"kitemetrics","model":"redwood/compact-v2-int4","canary":5}'

Ava (CS): :thumbsup: thanks team. Chaya — we'll loop you in on baseline exports this afternoon and confirm the Tue slot. If anything looks off during canary we'll auto-failover to standard-v1 and alert ops.

Priya K. (Solutions): I'll also push a routing policy that pins sessions to cached workers and send the policy id here.

Chaya @KiteMetrics: appreciated — looking forward. Please include a short post-canary summary with latency/cost deltas so we can present to execs.
